title: Local Minimax Robust Regret at Ordinal Ties with a Finite Utility-Elicitation Sample
banked_reason: D0.5.G: incremental below field floor, paper-score ceiling 6.2 < 7.4 and not salvageable in scope; five math-panel findings remain unrepaired, so soundness is not certified.
gap_reasons: The results concern one prespecified five-category uniform-margin tie in a covariate-free randomized trial, limiting their significance for broader ordinal policy learning.
The all-rule equality characterizes the finite-radius value through an unevaluated nine-dimensional optimization.
No evaluated stopping resolution, full-cube endpoints, or primal–dual record.

proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived a compact local Gaussian decision game, an analytic two-state information gap, and a critical-scaling transition, with seven cited sources independently attested. D0.5.G placed the package at incremental novelty, below the required field floor, largely because the full-cube certificate was not evaluated and the setting remained narrow. The math panel also reported unresolved arithmetic and certificate-input defects; this bank entry preserves an unverified attempt and must not be cited as a proved sound result.
tldr: At the uniform five-category ordinal tie, the all-rule local minimax excess robust regret with an independent Bernoulli utility sample equals a nine-dimensional product Gaussian value, attained uniformly by an observable count-plus-preference rule. The critical scale \(\kappa H^2\) has an exact scalar reduction: \(|V_H(\kappa)/H-W(\kappa H^2)|\le35H/2\). Its continuous nonincreasing curve has endpoints \(42/13\) and \(9/4\), and reaches \(9/4\) exactly at \(\lambda_{\mathrm{ord}}=16\pi/675\), distinct from the credited generic benchmark \(3\pi/25\). Strict full-game sampled-versus-supplied information prices, analytic fixed-case separation, and convergent rational certification algorithms complete the decision-theoretic results.
gap: Known-utility ordinal policy learning does not quantify the cost of a finite elicitation sample. Generic Gaussian transfer and directional-bound LAM rules supply neither this all-rule compact-cube risk order nor the conditional increasing-cell uniformity required here. The fixed-utility tie result concerns an eight-dimensional restricted experiment.
fill: Product ordinal and Bernoulli LAN, bounded finite-prior likelihood control, and conditional growing-cell transfer supply the equality and observable attainment. Strict full-game sampled-versus-supplied separation and four convergent outward bounds with a deterministic first successful resolution certify the information price. The constants and two-state calculation validate the loss geometry and certificate.
